title: Azhwar Vaibhavam-5
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt: Before getting into periyazhwar charithram, let us have a glance at the Great Villiputthoor charithram, where periyazhwar hailed from. In "Then Pandya" kingdom, there is a small town called putthoor, where great scholars pundits were residing. Nearby there is a forest where there were hunters living in it.
